condition: 2 pg Bacillus spizizenii DNA
source_detail: Mojarro A, Hachey J, Bailey R, Brown M, Doebler R, Ruvkun G, Zuber MT, Carr CE. 'Nucleic Acid Extraction and Sequencing from Low-Biomass Synthetic Mars Analog Soils for In Situ Life Detection.' Astrobiology 2019;19(9):1139-1152. doi:10.1089/ast.2018.1929. PMC6708270. Table 1 'Low-Input Carrier Sequencing Metrics', row 'B. subtilis reads': Number of reads = 5; Total bases = 5,270; min 848 bp, max 1,559 bp, median 967 bp. Input mass 2 pg from the abstract.
provenance_note: VERIFIED against the published Table 1. Both coordinates of this point are now citable: reads_per_fg = 5/(2*1000) = 0.0025 and bases_per_fg = 5270/(2*1000) = 2.635. Table 1 also reports the whole run for context - 1,303,007 reads and 8,698,026,598 bases total, of which only 29 reads were non-lambda - which is the same carrier-dominated regime this study operates in. Note the target read median of 967 bp, directly comparable to the per-class read lengths this pipeline reports.

condition: 10 pg of E. coli lenticule discs extract
source_detail: Raghavendra et al. 2023 reads (Zenodo 8208597, fastq_pass) run through THIS pipeline: minimap2 -ax map-ont competitive assignment against E. coli NCTC 9001 (GCA_900706755.1) and S. cerevisiae S288C (GCF_000146045.2). Counts from results_raghavendra/raghavendra_2023_ec_r1/competitive/.
provenance_note: Like-for-like variant: counted exactly as this study's own data, removing the mapping-vs-classification asymmetry. Direct alignment to a known reference is markedly more sensitive than Kraken2 against PlusPF-8 - over all 14 rows this variant recovers 1201 target reads against 437 for kraken2_q10 (2.75x). Comparing this study's mapping counts to Kraken2-based prior-study counts therefore overstates the improvement; this is the honest comparison. S. cerevisiae strain is an assumption (YSC-2 carries no strain designation); human reads are deliberately excluded, making these counts an upper bound.
